fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/francismarionsumter/recreation/brick-house-campground ('Overnight Use: Single Site: $5 per night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10145499/rates (2026 'Peak Season' PeakEquestrianNightly $5), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'Campsites are reservation only year round through recreation.gov. All sites available with same day reservations' - book before arriving and clip the confirmation to the site post. 14 days within 30 rolling days (Forest Order FM-19-01). 8 people, 2 vehicles and up to 2 horses per site.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10145499 (notice 'Campsites are reservation only year round through recreation.gov. All sites available with same day reservations'; rules maxStay 14 'Rolling 30 Days') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/francismarionsumter/recreation/brick-house-campground ('Reservations and payment must be made through recreation.gov'; 'Ensure you have a reservation before arrival'), read 2026-10-21

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/francismarionsumter/recreation/brick-house-campground ('Seasons of Use: All year'; 'open year-round'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10145499 ('There is no water, no electrical hookups, and no dump station available'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: One gravel loop of 21 sites; spurs 'vary in size and grade. Not all sites can accommodate all vehicles.' RIDB catalog driveways 30-72 ft, pull-throughs at sites 4 and 14. Every site is typed equestrian (up to two horses, highlined behind the white-banded trees) but open to RVs and tents.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10145499 ('year-round access to 21 campsites ... Campsite parking spurs are level and vary in size and grade. Not all sites can accommodate all vehicles'; 'Up to two horses per campsite are allowed') + RIDB campsite catalog (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20: 20 EQUESTRIAN NONELECTRIC sites, driveway 30-72 ft, Pull-through at 04 and 14), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Two double vault toilet buildings, one at each end of the loop; each site has a picnic table, fire ring and lantern post; cell coverage spotty.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10145499 ('Two, double vault toilet buildings are centrally located at each end of the campground. There is no water, no electrical hookups, and no dump station available'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Forest Service (Enoree Ranger District) campground: confirmed $5/night (fees manual); booking reservation-only on recreation.gov year-round incl. same-day, never first-come, 14-day limit; open all year; no hookups, water or dump; 21 sites (pull-throughs 4 and 14); two vault toilet buildings. Horses allowed at every site but not required. No forest alert for FSR 358 / SC 66. Note left as is.
